channel.title: Tech Kadak — naye free apps
channel.description: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.

item.title: GIMP
item.description: Photo editing ka free software: layers, masks, retouch, thumbnails, poster — Photoshop wala zyada-tar kaam.

item.title: Olauncher
item.description: Minimal home screen: icons ki jagah sirf apps ke naam, roz naya wallpaper. Phone kam scroll karna hai to kaam ka.

item.title: Krita
item.description: Digital painting aur drawing software: brushes, layers, animation — artists aur illustrators ke liye.

item.title: Indic Keyboard
item.description: Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Malayalam jaisi kai Indian languages ka keyboard — phonetic (English letters se Hindi) aur Inscript dono layouts. No ads.

item.title: Blender
item.description: 3D modelling, animation, VFX aur video editing — sab ek free software me. Bade studios bhi use karte hain.

item.title: Google AI Edge Gallery
item.description: Google ki official app — open-source AI models phone pe offline chalao: AI chat, Ask Image, audio transcribe. Data phone se bahar nahi jaata.

item.title: PocketPal AI
item.description: Phone pe AI chatbot bina internet — Gemma, Qwen, Llama jaise models download karo aur offline chat karo. No account.

item.title: Kiwix
item.description: Poori Wikipedia (aur aur content) offline padho — ek baar download, phir bina internet.

item.title: ChatterUI
item.description: Phone pe AI models chalao ya apne API provider se connect karo — open-source chat frontend.

item.title: KISS Launcher
item.description: Super-fast launcher: home screen pe bas ek search bar — 2-3 letter type karo aur app, contact ya setting turant khul jaata hai. Purane phone pe bhi tez.

item.title: MJ PDF Reader
item.description: Halka, fast PDF reader — dark mode, search, notes padhne ke liye best, no ads.

item.title: Fossify Voice Recorder
item.description: Simple voice recorder — lectures, voice notes record karo, bina ads.

item.title: Unciv
item.description: Sabse famous civilization-building strategy game ka open-source version — fast, chhota, no ads, free forever.

item.title: Whisper (offline voice typing)
item.description: OpenAI ke Whisper model se bolo aur text pao — voice recognition poori offline. Keyboard (IME) jaisa bhi use hota hai.

item.title: Maid
item.description: Open-source AI chat app — llama.cpp models phone pe local chalao, ya apni API key se online models.

item.title: Sky Map
item.description: Phone aasman ki taraf karo — stars, planets, constellations ke naam dikhata hai. Astronomy padhne ke liye mast.

item.title: Wikipedia
item.description: Wikipedia ki official app — 300+ languages mein articles, Hindi bhi. No ads, nonprofit.

item.title: Termux
item.description: Android pe Linux terminal — packages install karo, coding/Python seekho phone pe hi.

item.title: Gadgetbridge
item.description: Smartwatch/fitness band ko bina company ki cloud app ke chalao — data phone pe hi rehta hai.

item.title: Jitsi Meet
item.description: Free video meetings — account ke bina link share karo aur call shuru. Open-source.

item.title: Auxio
item.description: Simple, fast offline music player — apne downloaded gaane ke liye, no ads.

item.title: Feeder
item.description: RSS feed reader — apni favourite sites/blogs ki news ek jagah, bina account ke.

item.title: Thunderbird (Android)
item.description: Thunderbird ka 100% open-source, privacy-focused email app — Android pe.

item.title: Droid-ify
item.description: F-Droid ka fast, modern client — open-source apps dhoondo aur install karo, clean design mein.

item.title: NetGuard
item.description: Bina root firewall — chuno kaunsa app internet use kare, kaunsa nahi. Data aur battery bachao.

item.title: NotallyX
item.description: Minimal notes app: rich text notes, subtasks wali task lists, reminders, labels, PIN/fingerprint lock.

item.title: Open Camera
item.description: Feature-rich camera app: auto-stabilise, focus modes, face detection, timer, burst mode, silent shutter.

item.title: Trail Sense
item.description: Trekking/camping toolkit bina internet: beacons pe navigation, backtrack, sunset alert, compass aur weather prediction (sensor ho to).

item.title: WiFiAnalyzer
item.description: Ghar ka WiFi slow? Ye aas-paas ke networks aur channels dikhata hai — best channel chuno.

item.title: HeliBoard
item.description: Privacy-friendly open-source keyboard — internet permission hi nahi, themes + layouts ke saath.
